subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the morning after supper, when Queenie awoke from her afternoon nap around eight.
source_quote: She woke from her afternoon nap around eight, after supper

subject: elapsed time
fact: Thirty minutes passed between the disturbance and Queenie's awakening by Sylvira Savikas.
source_quote: only to be rudely awakened some thirty minutes later by our Sylvira Savikas

subject: chasme count
fact: Five years old, sleet-grey, and entirely uninterested — Queenie the cat is present.
source_quote: Queenie — five years old, sleet-grey, and entirely uninterested in being disturbed

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: The town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: the golden ass
fact: The book, dull enough to hold a person motionless and uninterested in scratching a cat, is 'The Golden Ass', missing and carried by Daral.
source_quote: The Golden Ass, the missing volume, walking out of the room under Daral's arm

subject: locket value
fact: The locket is intimate, carried always, never taken off — but its nature is unknown to Queenie.
source_quote: The locket itself is intimate. He carried it all the time. He never took it off. I don't know what it was.

subject: hightower library key location
fact: One key to the Hightower Library is held by Janussi; the other rests with Kalan, the gate warden.
source_quote: Fembris... supplied the column I was missing: Janussi held one of the two keys to the Hightower Library. The other key... rested with Kalan, the gate warden.

subject: shapeshifter encounter
fact: A figure wearing Sylvira's shape but none of her scent appeared — a shapeshifter impersonation.
source_quote: But she didn't smell like the demon lady, though. A figure wearing Sylvira and none of her scent.

subject: torn demon lady
fact: The torn demon lady came down the steps — Sylvira's shape, but not her scent.
source_quote: she'd prowled the nighttime cycle and seen the torn demon lady coming down the steps — Sylvira's shape

subject: hypnotic block
fact: The hypnotic block is not a device — it is a book, 'The Golden Ass', that immobilizes and disinterests.
source_quote: Every time they open that block, they just sit there and don't tickle! The Golden Ass, the missing volume

subject: daral's departure
fact: Daral exited with 'The Golden Ass' while the victim was still alive.
source_quote: Daral exited with the book, and the dead man was not yet dead.

subject: corridor retreat
fact: Queenie retreated to the corridor when Daral ran downstairs with the hypnotic block.
source_quote: she retreated to the corridor — 'when I later saw him run downstairs with a hypnotic block.'

subject: sylvira's attack
fact: Sylvira Savikas blasted the armchamber with a lance of unerring force light, waking Queenie.
source_quote: blasting the armchamber with a lance of unerring force light

subject: tickles count
fact: There have been too little Tickles and too many questions — Queenie's final assessment of the interrogation.
source_quote: There have been too little Tickles and too many questions.

subject: janussi's armchair
fact: Queenie had settled into Janussi's armchair for a nap before being awakened.
source_quote: She had settled into Janussi's armchair for a nap

subject: daz's tickle
fact: Daz gave Queenie a little tickle, which prompted her to deliver critical information.
source_quote: I'll give Queenie a little tickle," I said, and tickled.

subject: locket possession
fact: The locket was carried by Janussi at all times, never removed.
source_quote: He carried it all the time. He never took it off.

subject: zalthir's tv deduction
fact: Zalthir declared 'Oh, it's a TV!' — a misidentification that nonetheless arrived at the correct functional conclusion.
source_quote: Oh, it's a TV!" said Zalthir, which was not quite the deduction but arrived at the same destination.

subject: thorin's force bolt inquiry
fact: Thorin questioned why the bolts of force were being used — prompting the revelation of Sylvira’s attack.
source_quote: what was going on with those bolts of force, do we know why

subject: tower corridor
fact: Queenie retreated to the tower corridor upon seeing Daral’s action.
source_quote: she retreated to the corridor

subject: queenie's final dismissal
fact: Queenie dismissed the party with the instruction to lick themselves before returning.
source_quote: You may now leave, and please give yourself a proper licking before returning to my tower.

subject: hightower library key possession
fact: The key to the Hightower Library held by Janussi was the key that explained the deletion of forbidden text.
source_quote: That might explain why that stuff got deleted off that book that no one should have touched.

subject: queenie's breath-holding habit
fact: Queenie holds her breath whenever a two-legger passes, judging them unclean.
source_quote: I try to hold my breath whenever a two-legger passes. It's clear that you hardly ever lick yourselves at all.

subject: grygum's expense reduction
fact: Someone else had taken an expense off Grygum's account, relieving him.
source_quote: someone else had just taken an expense off his account

subject: daz's final tickle offer
fact: Daz offered more tickles and padding to settle the account fully.
source_quote: More tickles, more padding," I offered, because the account wasn't quite settled.
